answer: An agent marketplace can force every identity to post a real stake, like an oasis where each palm tree costs water to plant. To trade, an agent locks tokens as collateral in a basalt-hard ledger; any proven cheat burns the bond. Spinning up a thousand Sybil identities means locking a thousand stakes, and honest agents earn a jade tier of discounted fees over time. The attack cost grows linearly with each fake identity, making mass Sybils ruinously expensive while genuine newcomers pay once.
